models_evaluated: Named Entity Recognition-based NLP pipeline with contextual analysis

links.outcome: Positive predictive value of NLP flags with vs without human review
links.effect: PPV improved from 55.4% (NLP alone) to 78.4% with human-in-the-loop review; T4d-only 57.1% to 90.9%, suspected-only 40.2% to 63.2%.
links.quote: Adding a human-in-the-loop review improved the overall PPV to 78.4%, with notable gains in patient charts containing T4d (90.9%) and suspected inflammatory breast cancer tags (63.2%).

unlisted_practices: NLP-based case-finding to identify rare cancer patients for referral to specialized clinics

models_evaluated: Institution-developed NLP pipeline using Named Entity Recognition and contextual analysis

links.outcome: Positive predictive value after human validation of NLP-flagged cases
links.effect: Human-in-the-loop review increased overall PPV from 55.4% to 78.4%; PPV reached 90.9% for T4d tags and 63.2% for suspected inflammatory breast cancer tags.
links.quote: Adding a human-in-the-loop review improved the overall PPV to 78.4%, with notable gains in patient charts containing T4d (90.9%) and suspected inflammatory breast cancer tags (63.2%).

links.outcome: Confirmed inflammatory breast cancer cases missed by the NLP-plus-human screening system
links.effect: Among 255 confirmed cases, the system identified 235 and missed 20, yielding sensitivity of 92.2%; negative predictive value was 33.3%.
links.quote: Of 255 confirmed paients with inflammatory breast cancer in this cohort, our NLP plus human-in-the-loop system correctly identified 235 cases (true positives), missing 20 cases (false negatives), yielding a sensitivity of 92.2%.

links.effect: Of 255 confirmed inflammatory breast cancer cases, 57 (22.4%) were identified solely by the AI pipeline and would have been missed by traditional surveillance.
links.quote: Of these confirmed cases, 57 (22.4%) were identified solely through the NLP pipeline and would have been missed through traditional surveillance methods.

links.effect: Initial NLP screening had a 55.4% positive predictive value, which improved to 78.4% when a human-in-the-loop review was added.
links.quote: Initial NLP screening achieved 55.4% positive predictive value, improving to 78.4% with human-in-the-loop review.

unlisted_practices: Using a multi-stage sequential review process (NLP screening followed by human validation and multidisciplinary confirmation) to accurately identify rare diseases in large populations.
